note: Six shared post layouts. Slot limits are the physical ceiling for each layout; a brand's social-rules can be stricter. The caption slot is never drawn on the image.

templates.name: Photo-led
templates.description: Photo fills the top two thirds; headline and subhead sit on the background below it. Optional badge sits on a tape label over the photo's lower-left corner.

badge.note: The one accent element, handwritten. A date or box number.

templates.name: Type-led
templates.description: No photo. A large headline and one or two plain sentences; the instruction is the content. Optional handwritten note.

badge.note: Handwritten note, the one accent element.

templates.name: Quote card
templates.description: A member's words, large, with attribution. No wordmark, so nothing competes with the quote.

quote.note: Must be the exact words supplied in the brief.

badge.note: Optional handwritten note, the one accent element.

templates.name: Split
templates.description: Photo on the left half, full height; headline, subhead and call to action on the right half.

templates.name: Offer badge
templates.description: Photo on top with a stamp-style badge over its corner carrying the offer (a price or a box number); headline, subhead and call to action below.

badge.note: The stamp. The offer in a few characters, e.g. a price. The one accent element.

templates.name: Event card
templates.description: Event name, a large handwritten date (the accent element), then time and place, so the when and where read at a glance.

date.note: Exactly as given in the brief.

details.note: Time and place, exactly as given in the brief.
